City council approves the transit plan

By M. Reporter · 17 November 2026

RIVERSIDE — The council voted 7 to 2 on Monday to fund the second phase of the transit plan, ending eighteen months of study with a decision that will change how the east side reaches the centre.

FundingCritics

Funding

The plan pays for six new trams and a depot at the old goods yard. A third of the money comes from the regional fund, which must be claimed before March.

"We are not buying trams, we are buying twenty years of predictable commutes," one councillor said before the vote.

Critics

Two councillors voted against the plan, arguing that the depot site should be sold for housing instead. The debate lasted just under two hours.
